what_this_is: A machine-readable TRANSCRIPTION of the named-correct neighbour lists that were frozen in docs/WIRE-PREDICTIONS-2026-08-09.md BEFORE the 2026-08-09 wire experiment ran. It exists so the milestone-2 retrieval can be graded against a panel written by a human before the thing being graded existed.
what_this_is_not: Not new relevance labels, not a model-generated judgement, not semantic authority, and not a target. No name below was added, removed, corrected or substituted during transcription. Nothing in this file may be edited to improve a measurement result; a disagreement between this file and the source document is a defect in this file.

historical_regression_context.use: CONTEXT ONLY. it records that the naive membership wire FAILED 2 of its 3 pre-committed criteria and PASSED 1. section 5 grades criterion 1 (an anchor gains a named-correct neighbour it could not reach) FAIL, criterion 2 (no anchor loses a correct neighbour) FAIL, and criterion 3 (the controls come back byte-identical) PASS. milestone 2 does not lower, rewrite or re-grade that bar, and does not reuse its scoring
historical_regression_context.count_correction: M2.R1 repair A, from Manager review 5593405124. an earlier draft of the field above stated the inverse count -- one failure instead of two -- by reading the source document's own summary line, which reports the single PASS, as though it reported a single FAILURE. the verdict ROWS of section 5 are the authority for this field, not that summary line, and the historical document itself was not edited. recorded rather than silently overwritten, so a reviewer can see which statement moved and why.
